Computer Fundamentals.question: ১) What is the name of the chip which has more than once processor on it?
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Transputer : is a microprocessor with integral memory designed for parallel processing, for scientific, real-time control and AI applications.
It contains a CPU, memory and communications capability all in a single chip.

Computer Fundamentals.exp: Scratchpad is a high-speed internal memory used for temporary storage of calculations, data, and other work in progress.

Computer Fundamentals.exp:

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৪) Regarding a VDU, which statement is more correct?
Computer Fundamentals.option1: ক) It is an output device
Computer Fundamentals.option2: খ) It is an input device
Computer Fundamentals.option3: গ) It is a peripheral device
Computer Fundamentals.option4: ঘ) It is a hardware item
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Visual display unit (VDU) or video display terminal (VDT): any device used with computers to display images.
It typically consists of a computer monitor or similar display device and a keyboard, and could also include a mouse.
For example, a flat panel display and a projector are both examples of VDUs.
So, it is a peripheral device.

Computer Fundamentals.exp:

Computer Fundamentals.question: ১০) The time for which a piece of equipment operates is called
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Access time is related to the time taken to access a piece of information from the memory, let it the RAM or anything else.
Seek time is related to the Storage Disks. It is the time taken by the head to get to the required position from the current position in order to read the data.
I don't know the exact meaning of the Real Time, but according to what I read, real time is relative to the user than any system. If a user requests for any service, in what time does it get serviced is Real Time.
So, Effective Time make more sense here. Given an equipment that you are working on, how long will it work for is its effective usage time.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ১১) Which computer has been designed to be as compact as possible?
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
A microcomputer is a small, relatively inexpensive computer with a microprocessor as its central processing unit (CPU).
It includes a microprocessor, memory, and input/output (I/O) facilities. Microcomputers became popular in the 1970s and 80s with the advent of increasingly powerful microprocessors.

Computer Fundamentals.exp: A packet-switched network is a digital communications network that groups all transmitted data, irrespective of content, type, or structure into suitably sized blocks.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ২৪) What does that acronym VGA stand for?
Computer Fundamentals.exp: Abbreviation of Video Graphics Array, a graphics display system for PCs developed by IBM. VGA has become one of the de facto standards for PCs. In text mode, VGA systems provide a resolution of 720 by 400 pixels.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ২৫) A floppy disk contains
Computer Fundamentals.option3: গ) Both circular tracks and sector
Computer Fundamentals.exp: A floppy disk or floppy diskette (sometimes casually referred to as a floppy or diskette) is a type of disk storage composed of a thin and flexible disk of a magnetic storage medium in a square or nearly square plastic enclosure lined with a fabric that removes dust particles from the spinning disk.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ২৬) A 32 bit microprocessor has the word length equal to
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
32 bits = (4x8) bits.
8 bits equals a byte.
Therefore 32 bits = 4 multiples of byte.= 4bytes.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ২৮) What technology is used for flat panel displays?
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Solid-state display technology : refers to electronic components, devices, and systems based entirely on the semiconductor.
Integrated circuit (IC), the light-emitting diode (LED), and liquid-crystal display (LCD) are examples of solid-state devices.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ২৯) Which term is not used to describe the memory component of a computer?
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Sequential access memory (SAM) : is data storage devices that read stored data in a sequence. This is in contrast to RAM where data can be accessed in any order. SAM devices are usually a form of magnetic storage.
So it is not a memory component of a PC, it is a secondary storage devices.

Computer Fundamentals.exp:
Adder : is a unit which adds together two input variables.
Half-adder can only add the inputs together.
Full-adder can add a bit carried from another addition as well as the two inputs.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৩২) Which of the following is used as 'Input device' for the computer?
Computer Fundamentals.exp: A light pen, also called a selector pen, is a computer input device in the form of a light-sensitive wand used in conjunction with a computer's CRT display. It allows the user to point to displayed objects or draw on the screen in a similar way to a touchscreen but with greater positional accuracy.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৩৬) A section of code that may only be executed by one process at any one time is
Computer Fundamentals.exp: A critical section is a piece of code that accesses a shared resource (data structure or device) that must not be concurrently accessed by more than one thread of execution.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৩৭) Which of the following is also known as SOROBAN
Computer Fundamentals.exp: The Soroban, or Japanese abacus. It consists of a wooden frame, which holds columns of beads.For hundreds of years, this tool was used by bankers and merchants as the original calculator.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৩৮) Which of the following machines are characterised by electronic tube circuitry, delay line, rotating or electrostatic memory.
Computer Fundamentals.exp:
First generation of computers : started in 1946 with ENIAC, the first 'computer' to use electronic valves (ie. Vacuum tubes).
Second Generation (1956-1963) : Transistors replace vacuum tubes and ushered in the second generation of computers.
Third generation (1965-1971) : used integrated circuits (IC's) in place of transistors. A single IC has many transistors, resistors and capacitors along with the associated circuitry.
The fourth generation computers : uses microprocessor, microprocessor is a silicon chip contains millions of transistors. These computers uses LSI (Large Scale Integration) and VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) technology. That was designed using LSI and VLSI technology.
Fifth generation computing devices : based on artificial intelligence, some applications, such as voice recognition, that are being used today.
The use of parallel processing and superconductors is helping to make artificial intelligence a reality.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৪৮) A physical connection between the microprocessor memory and other parts of the microcomputer is known as
Computer Fundamentals.exp: An address bus is a computer bus architecture. It is used to transfer data between devices. The devices are identified by the hardware address of the physical memory (the physical address). The address is stored in the form of binary numbers to enable the data bus to access memory storage.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৪৯) An IBM System/38 represents the computer class of:
Computer Fundamentals.exp: The System/38 is a discontinued minicomputer and midrange computer server platform manufactured and sold by the IBM Corporation. IBM announced the System/38 in 1978.The System/38 has 48-bit addressing, which was unique for the time, and a novel integrated database system.

Computer Fundamentals.question: ৫০) A digital device that processes data is known as
Computer Fundamentals.exp: Data processing is, generally, 'the collection and manipulation of items of data to produce meaningful information'. In this sense it can be considered a subset of information processing, the change (processing) of information in any manner detectable by an observer.
